entries.evidence: PR 'Compare window partitions as sets' (fixes duckdb/duckdb#24629): PartitionsAreEquivalent compared two window expressions' PARTITION BY lists by length plus one-directional membership, so 'a, a' matched 'a, b'. Triggering needs two or more window expressions with PARTITION BY and a duplicated partition key. See docs/UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md item 16.
